verdict.rationale: Gitea documents a general API and webhooks for building custom workflows, and community evidence shows some actions (e.g., creating private repos) can bypass the UI entirely, suggesting solid API coverage. However, the evidence pack lacks any first-party API reference/OpenAPI docs (probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404) or explicit claims of full UI-API parity, so comprehensiveness is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: authoritative API reference/spec, explicit parity claims, and hands-on confirmation that all UI actions (e.g., merges, admin settings, package management) are API-accessible.
